_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit/wiring.mjs. Every entry carries the reason it is deliberate. A new entry is added only after review, in the same commit as the change that needs it.

anon_executes.public.cms_list(p_kind text, p_locale te: the live CMS pages of a kind (0114, X-094): the sitemap and the article index; published words only
anon_executes.public.cms_media_file(p_key text): an image a public page shows, by its exact 32-hex address (0124, D-169), as org_logo (0104): nothing about a person in it
anon_executes.public.cms_page(p_kind text, p_slug text: a live CMS page (0114, X-094): the public site's own words, only what is published and not archived; stable, reads nothing about a person
anon_executes.public.cms_preview(p_token text, p_local: a draft through its preview link (0114, X-094): a 256-bit token, looked up by its SHA-256, expiring in an hour; the page is marked noindex and framed only by the admin
anon_executes.public.cms_redirect(p_path text): where an old address goes (0114, X-094): only a redirect an admin made; its one write is that address's visit counter, which a visitor may raise but not read
anon_executes.public.crm_archive(p_limit integer): newsletter web archive (D-101), published issues only
anon_executes.public.crm_archive_item(p_slug text): one archived newsletter issue by slug (D-101)
anon_executes.public.crm_newsletter_signup(p_email tex: newsletter signup form, honeypot and rate limit in the function (D-101)
anon_executes.public.crm_preferences(p_token text): preference centre behind a mail's token (D-101)
anon_executes.public.crm_public_lists(): the lists a visitor may sign up for (D-101)
anon_executes.public.csat_open(p_token text): a support case's rating page (0135, /vurdering): a 256-bit one-use key minted by the dispatcher's claim, looked up by its SHA-256, expiring in 30 days; answers the case number or one `invalid` for malformed, unknown, expired and used keys; a miss is counted, 200 in ten minutes closes it for everyone; the page is noindex
anon_executes.public.csat_submit(p_token text, p_ratin: the rating itself (0135): 1–5 and an optional comment, once per key; the input is checked before the key; a spent key answers exactly as an unknown one; same miss count and limit as csat_open
anon_executes.public.demo_request(p_email text, p_name: demo sandbox request with name, company and role, rate-limited (D-143, D-191)
anon_executes.public.entry_info(p_code text): QR poster page: round name by entry code (D-126)
anon_executes.public.follow_up(p_key text, p_body text: respondent's private conversation, by its key (0018)
anon_executes.public.message_overrides(p_locale text): approved bokmål/English overrides, public page text (0101)
anon_executes.public.org_logo(p_key text): an organisation's logo by its exact 32-hex address (0104, D-154): shown in the survey, the round page and mails; no row, no id, nothing about a person
anon_executes.public.request_link(p_code text, p_conta: QR poster: send my own link, rate-limited (D-126)
anon_executes.public.respond_locales(p_token text): the survey's offered languages by token (0079)
anon_executes.public.round_page(p_slug text): employees' results page, whole organisation, k-gated (0100)
anon_executes.public.site_indexing(): whether search engines may index the public site (0126, D-170): one boolean, set only by a super-admin, read by the public layout and the sitemap
anon_executes.public.site_notice(p_locale text): the public site notice (0123, X-095): text only, nothing while it is off; written only by admin_site_notice_set (cms_can_write, audited)
anon_executes.public.submit_response(p_token text, p_a: the one write path for answers (invariant 3)
anon_executes.public.thread_by_key(p_key text): respondent's conversation read, by its key (0018)

client_writes.app.employees: register, RLS: daglig leder of the org
client_writes.app.org_questions: own questions, RLS (0095 adds the RPC path)
client_writes.app.evaluations: evaluations of the ordning (0103, D-153), RLS: daglig leder or verneombud of the org insert/delete

unread_columns.mail_events.received_at: delivery log: kept for support and the audit trail, read in SQL by hand
unread_columns.org_count_answers.answered_on: record of when a count answer was given; no reader by design (anonymity: never joined)
unread_columns.round_translations.pinned_at: audit stamp of when a round's wording was pinned (0086)

uncalled_rpcs.results_summary: called by results_digest (0044) in SQL; callable directly, checks membership and k itself
uncalled_rpcs.results_items: called by results_workspace in SQL; checks membership and k itself
uncalled_rpcs.results_importance: called by results_workspace in SQL; checks membership and k itself
uncalled_rpcs.results_workspace: called by results_digest (0044) in SQL; checks membership and k itself

app_only_settings.organizations.law_mode: the help pages switch to their law-framed articles (app/(app)/hjelp)
app_only_settings.organizations.registry_registered_on: a Brønnøysund fact shown in Oppsett › Selskap; not a setting
app_only_settings.organizations.registry_vat: a Brønnøysund fact shown in Oppsett › Selskap; not a setting
app_only_settings.organizations.industry_source: how the industry was set; lib/modules/read suggests modules from it
app_only_settings.organizations.industry_suggested: the registry's suggestion; lib/modules/read offers it
app_only_settings.evaluations.counterpart: who took part in the § 9-2 evaluation: printed by Rapport's evaluation line (components/rapport/RapportScreen.tsx, «Evaluert {date} med {who}.»); a record, not a setting
